title: I made a blackjack roguelite — free demo, looking for brutal feedback
author: DOFFY292
selftext: I’ve just launched the free demo for SOFT17 on Steam, and I’d love to get some constructive feedback. Before everyone comments on my use of AI for the Steam capsule art: I am currently looking for an artist to design professional-quality capsules; the current ones are just placeholders. I would really appreciate both positive and negative feedback so I can improve the game. And if you have any questions about certain parts of my workflow, I’d be happy to answer them. Thanks everyone — here is the link to the demo page: [**https://store.steampowered.com/app/5284030/Soft\_17/**](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5284030/Soft_17/)
